text_block_list.text: One day, during a run—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
“—Alrighty then! Shelf repair, all done 
and dusted! That oughta hold for a good 
while.”

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to trouble you, Inari-chan. I know 
you're in the middle of training, yet you 
stopped to help.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aw, carpentry's my specialty! A job like 
this is a piece of cake.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, it's not much of a thank-you, 
but... I happen to have some daifuku, so 
take a few with you.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Much obliged!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —And so, I gratefully accepted it, ya see.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's a gift from someone else. Before it 
goes bad, I reckon I'll brew some tea and 
enjoy it right up—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um! Inari-senpai! Thank you so much for 
giving me running advice the other day!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I made some inari sushi as a thank-you, so 
please have some if you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Well now, aren't you sweet to do 
something nice for me. Don't mind if I—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Senpai! Thank you so much for helping me 
search for my contact lens the other day! 
I made some dango as a thank-you!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: O-Oh?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
"Senpai! Thank you so much for helping 
find a foster home for that stray cat! 
Here, I brought some rice balls for you!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume E
text_block_list.text:
Inari-senpai, thank you so much for 
treating me the other day! I made some 
oden, so please have some!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
W-What's all this, what's all this, what's 
all this?! What the heck is going on 
here?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there's a limit to everything! 
And all of it being food is just too much 
to handle...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um, Senpai? Things kind of got completely 
out of hand, so if it's alright, maybe we 
could remake it another day...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Get outta here! Don't go selling me 
short!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Did ya really think the great Inari-sama 
would let your feelings go to waste?! I'll 
gladly take every last bit of 'em!"

text_block_list.name: Juniors
text_block_list.text: Ooh! As expected of Inari-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Well now, how should I devour 
this?
choice_data_list: Let's eat it all before we feel full!

Why don't we all taste it together 
instead?

The only thing to do is move around and 
work up an appetite.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! By the time that bastard fullness 
catches up to me, I'll already be relaxing 
with my post-meal tea!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whip it up quick, and then savor every 
bite... Time to dig in!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Phew...! Thank you for the meal!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Amazing...! You really ate it all! Are you 
okay though, Senpai?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it was a piece of cake! The inari 
sushi had great dashi broth, it was 
exquisite! Come to think of it, the rice 
balls had kelp dashi too—

text_block_list.name: Juniors
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, as expected of you, Senpai...! You 
really savored every bite...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, eating good food got my strength 
pumping again! Shall we give it another 
push today?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Urk... Th-Thanks for the meal... burp...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I-Inari-senpai!? Are you all right!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... that was delicious... Thanks... a 
lot...!

text_block_list.name: Juniors
text_block_list.text: I... Inari-senpaaaai!!

Though she managed to finish every last 
bite... Inari One didn't feel like eating 
anything for the next two days.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Now that's what I'm talkin' about! Sounds 
like a real little banquet!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, then should I go prepare some tea? And 
maybe grab a picnic mat while I'm at it...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, countin' on ya! Since you're at it, 
might as well go call over your friends 
too!

And so, a little banquet was held in a 
corner of the course.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's how it is. That said, if you 
take your sweet time, all this nice food's 
gonna spoil.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, I'd like to pack my 
training with a super stacked menu. I'm 
counting on you, Trainer!

Inari One worked up an appetite from her 
intense training... and managed to devour 
all of the food gifts happily.
